markdown:
Most people loose photos not to hardware failure but to a lost or stolen phone. A backup that lives only on the same device is not a backup.

Turn on iCloud Photos or Google Photos so new pictures upload automatically over wifi. Then, perhaps once a month, copy the library to an external drive and keep that drive somewhere other than your desk. Two copies in two places survive almost everything short of a house fire.

Check the backup twice a year by opening a few old photos from the drive. A backup you have never restored from is a hope, not a plan.
